about: Sarnia is in southwestern Ontario, where the St. Clair River leaves Lake Huron toward Lake St. Clair. It is a petrochemical and refining city—often called Chemical Valley—linked to Port Huron, Michigan, by the Blue Water Bridge. Beaches, a wide river, and prevailing southwest winds shape the waterfront. About 72,000 people live in Sarnia.
